basic_info.description: Mid-Century view condo in Diamond Heights. This top floor unit features an open living space with floor to ceilings windows (18 ft high!) & a walkout deck, a spacious dining room and a contemporary kitchen. The main level also provides one of two primary bedrooms with an en-suite bath and copious storage space. Upstairs, is the second primary and a bedroom/office with stunning views and an en-suite bathroom. Additionally, there is in-unit laundry, deeded storage, two car garage parking, and a building pool! Quick access to surrounding neighborhoods, parks, and public transportation.
